def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v}, key=lambda c: min(x for row in grid for x,v in enumerate(row) if v == c))
    objs = []
    for c in colors:
        cells = [(r, col) for r in range(h) for col in range(w) if grid[r][col] == c]
        r0=min(r for r,x in cells); r1=max(r for r,x in cells)
        c0=min(x for r,x in cells); c1=max(x for r,x in cells)
        shape={(r-r0,x-c0) for r,x in cells}
        objs.append((c,shape,max(y for y,x in shape)+1,max(x for y,x in shape)+1))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    r=c0=0
    for color,shape,oh,ow in objs:
        for dr,dc in shape:
            if 0 <= r+dr < h and 0 <= c0+dc < w: out[r+dr][c0+dc]=color
        r += oh-1; c0 += ow-1
    return out
